rule.description: Custom Detection: PowerShell spawned encoded PowerShell command

_note: Real, live-fired alert for Rules/execution-obfuscated-command.xml's Windows rule (100201), run against dc01-lab. The -EncodedCommand base64 payload decodes (UTF-16LE) to `Write-Output 'WAZUH-NATIVE-LIVE-180129'` - a distinctive marker from this live test session, confirming this is a genuine simulation run rather than incidental system activity. Rule 100201 fired 3 separate times across repeated test runs (firedtimes 1, 2, 3) with no shadowing from any other rule on this manager, unlike the Windows Persistence rule (100211), which required chaining under a pre-existing community Sysmon rule (92302) before it could win the match - see Rules/persistence-run-key-cron.xml and Evidence/t1053-windows-validation.json for that investigation. Captured verbatim via `docker exec single-node-wazuh.manager-1 sh -c 'grep -F "EncodedCommand" /var/ossec/logs/archives/archives.json'`, no content altered.
